content.text:
Greens are a classic fight at 28 months, and it's usually about control, not taste. Try putting one small green thing on his plate next to something he already likes, and don't comment on it or push a bite. Toddlers often need many calm, no-pressure looks before they taste. Letting him wash or tear the broccoli or spinach can help too.

Also, I told you earlier I couldn't sign kids up for things. I can try now once you say yes. Want me to look for a class for him?
